bugs_found: review-gate documentation says latest overall round must approve, but implementation never checks the latest round overall verdict; a later math-auditor/request-changes round can still pass if code-reviewer approved
review-gate deduplicates findings by filename sort order rather than by actual round number, despite the comment; lexicographic ordering makes round-10 sort before round-2 and can use stale ack state
cmd_review_validate and cmd_review_gate load schema files without handling FileNotFoundError/JSONDecodeError, causing uncaught crashes instead of documented configuration error exit code 2
function_is_exempted indexes exemption fields directly, so malformed profile entries can crash contract-presence instead of producing a validation/configuration failure
cmd_all runs later checks even after profile-validate fails, so malformed profiles can trigger misleading results or crashes
